after.zh: 只有乘积 f·b 要紧：焦距翻倍、基线减半，测出来的距离一模一样。挑相机时比的是这个乘积。
after.en: Only the product f·b matters: double the focal length and halve the baseline and the distances come out exactly the same. When choosing a camera, this product is what to compare.

t.zh: 换一台双目相机，镜头和两台相机的间距都变了。
t.en: Switch to a different stereo camera: both the lens and the distance between the two cameras change.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：每组测试给出焦距 f 和基线 b，把视差图换成距离图。
t.en: Your task in this level: each test gives the focal length f and the baseline b; turn the disparity map into a distance map.

brief.zh: 换了一台双目相机，焦距 f 和基线 b 每组测试都不一样。把视差图换成距离图。
brief.en: A different stereo camera: the focal length f and the baseline b change from test to test. Turn the disparity map into a distance map.

hint.zh: <level-ref to="7-3"></level-ref>的 3 是哪两个数相乘来的？
hint.en: Which two numbers multiplied together made <level-ref to="7-3"></level-ref>'s 3?
